prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Rhodium (로듐) itself — the sovereign of the Rhodium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late thirties — a glamorous, alluring mature beauty in her prime: confident, sensual poise, a knowing gaze and a ripe, womanly figure; smooth, radiant skin with at most the faintest lines at the eye corners; never old, tired, gaunt or matronly — still the small, soft chin and soft contours.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: rhodium: a hard, brilliant silver-white metal that never tarnishes, found in 1804 in the residue of platinum ore after palladium had been drawn out, and named from the Greek for rose because its salts are rose-red; plated over white gold, mirrors and searchlight reflectors it gives the whitest, most lasting shine; one of the rarest precious metals, it has at times cost more than ten times as much as gold, the most expensive metal of all; most of it works unseen inside car catalytic converters, turning the nitrogen oxides of exhaust back into clean nitrogen. Palette: brilliant mirror white, rose-salt pink, deep rose red, cool platinum grey.

World (fixed): in the 1930s, a plating workshop in London's Hatton Garden jewellery quarter: rows of glass plating baths of red-brown solution, white-gold rings that come out dazzling white, great searchlight mirror reflectors leaning against the walls, shelves of rose-red salt jars and fresh-plated rings glittering on velvet. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a fitted bodice and a long bustled ball gown sweeping out behind her, long gloves — an elegant, wide-trailing shape; 2) a long tailcoat over a waistcoat, a small silk top hat and a pocket-watch chain — a gentleman inventor's upright shape; 3) a double-breasted military greatcoat below the knee with brass buttons and epaulettes, tall boots — an angular, commanding shape; 4) a many-pocketed expedition jacket, a wide-brimmed hat, a cross-body satchel and laced boots — a far-travelling explorer's shape; 5) a short naval frock coat with gold braid, a captain's cap and a sash catching the wind — a seafarer's shape; 6) an open crinoline cage of brass hoops below the waist under a sheer overskirt — a birdcage-wide shape; 7) layered linen with a wide-brimmed hat, a belt of glass specimen jars and vine motifs — a greenhouse botanist's soft shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): brilliant mirror white, rose-salt pink, deep rose red, cool platinum grey.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): brilliant mirror-white platinum hair with a warm rose-pink glow in its depths. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Rh) and atomic number (45) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Chosen original design: silhouette 2, inventor tailcoat over waistcoat, small silk top hat and pocket-watch chain. Mature woman with porcelain beige skin, amber eyes, softly rounded heart face, subtle freckles, softly smiling lips; loose long straight mirror-white platinum hair with warm rose glow, no updo. Deep rose tailcoat with mirror-white split lapels built as nested concave reflector segments, rose-pink waistcoat with deep neckline, short platinum grey tailored shorts and tall white lace-up boots, empty white gloved hands relaxed open at sides. Front facing, casual crossed-ankle standing beside large reflector in bright jewellery workshop; rose-red glass baths and white rings behind her. One hand lightly poised palm up without holding anything. Preserve fixed brief.

generation.note: Original PNG preserved; only WebP committed.
